The '''XA Classic bipod''' was a model of weapon [[bipod]] available in the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The mount was produced by [[Galactic Arms]] and sold for 100 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], being compatible with [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]], [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]] and [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]]. When attached, it stabilised a weapon if deployed and increased its firing characteristics.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The XA Classic was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
